remarks: **A Rare Norwalk Opportunity with Character, History & Versatility!**  Welcome to 13 North Avenue, a distinctive Norwalk property offering approximately 7,068 square feet of space on a generous 0.55-acre parcel. Steeped in history and character, this unique property presents an exciting opportunity for an owner-user, investor, organization, entrepreneur or developer seeking a highly visible location with established community presence.  Originally constructed in 1915, the property combines classic character with the flexibility needed for a variety of uses. The expansive interior provides abundant room for gatherings, events, recreation, dining, offices, or other potential commercial and community-oriented applications, as well as up to a 14 unit housing unit development, all subject to zoning and approvals. Buyer required to do their own due diligence.  The property is currently associated with the longstanding Laurel Athletic Club, a well-established Norwalk institution with deep roots in the local community. The existing layout includes space well suited for social functions, private events, athletic and recreational activities, and group gatherings.  Located in a convenient Norwalk setting with access to major roadways, public transportation, shopping, dining, and area amenities, 13 North Avenue offers a rare combination of size, location, history, and great potential. Building and Property sold AS-IS.
